entities.title: Structural schema
entities.summary: One JSON Schema per specification MAJOR.MINOR; today schema/utv-1.0.schema.json (Draft 2020-12, $id urn:utv:schema:1.0).
entities.purpose: Defines the serialized field names and shapes of UTV values, so that any tool can reject malformed JSON before semantic validation.
boundaries: Shapes only: the specification governs meaning, and a value can pass the schema and still be semantically invalid or unresolvable.
Older schema files are never changed when newer ones are added.
